name: test-management-kit
description: Test cases as plain data, a validator, exporters for TestRail and other tools, and a TestRail result reporter and Jira issue creator tested against a local mock

scripts.dry-run:testrail: node src/cli.ts report-testrail --results examples/run-results.json --map examples/testrail-map.json --base-url https://example.testrail.io --dry-run
scripts.dry-run:jira: node src/cli.ts create-jira --results examples/run-results.json --project KIT --base-url https://example.atlassian.net --dry-run
